lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Something drops onto the cobbles from a rooftop, light as a cat.

lines.speaker: needles
lines.text: Don't look so pleased. I came back for my own reasons.

lines.speaker: needles
lines.text: Your purse was empty. They'll take my sword too, once they're done with yours.

lines.speaker: needles
lines.text: I'm {needles_bearer}. I know every alley in this town. Try to keep up.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: Thousand Needles. Loud, as I said.
